trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are done. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), so treat this as the finish line, not a goal of its own: finish the story, work the roadmap in order, and mop up activities and collectibles last.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy: finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening mission. It pops as part of the story, so just play through the intro.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 1. Keep a manual save at the end of each chapter — there is no mission replay, and a save per chapter is your safety net if you miss an optional interaction.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 2. Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 3. Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish Chapter 4. Just keep playing the story.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Unmissable: finish the final story mission. After it, free roam stays open, so the rest of the list can be cleaned up at your own pace.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete Breakfast Run when it comes up in the story.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete The Cartel Heist.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete the VCIA Takedown.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Unmissable story mission: complete Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The biggest grind in the game: reach 100% completion, roughly 100 hours after the story. Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion for the live checklist. The big numbers: 39 Gang Operations, 22 Bank Jobs, 7 Payday Loan Jobs, 8 bank vaults, 100 optional tasks, 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, 42 Shooting Range golds, 42 Drone Time Trials, 300 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 Bret Target Decks, 200 vehicles scanned, 100 animals studied, 50 weapons. Only the listed portions count — don't hunt everything.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 unique stunts across Leonida — jumps, near-misses and trick driving all count. The 100% checklist asks for 300 of 397, so keep stunting past this trophy. Check your count under Progress.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types once: races, shooting range, fishing, arcade, pool, mini golf, basketball, drone races and bowling. One try each is enough — you don't need to win any of them.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Every range lists its gold threshold in-game. All 42 golds are also required for 100% completion, so this is not optional for the platinum.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. The 42 Drone Time Trials across those locations are also part of 100% completion. Learn each course's line before racing the clock.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Races unlock across Leonida as you explore; 100% completion wants 30 of 40 unique races won, so keep racing past 20.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot and win the fishing minigame against him — steady reeling beats fast reeling.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet and play a game through to its end; the 100% checklist also asks you to play all four video games.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's final mission, Puff Puff Pass. Follow Andy's stranger strand to its end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Kenton's strand also ties into treasure hunting — 5 of his 7 treasure sets count toward 100% completion.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's final mission. Follow Billy's stranger strand to its end.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Stranger missions appear as you explore; some chains have windows tied to story progress, so start them when they appear rather than leaving them all until after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Follow Randy's stranger strand to its end.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's final mission. Follow Tyrone's stranger strand to its end.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. DO THIS FIRST: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house in the morning — she'll mention meditating and walk to the balcony. Follow her and accept. This balcony meditation may be required and it is gone after Chapter 1 (unconfirmed whether it counts, so do it to be safe). The other spots sit across 10 locations; meditating with both Jason and Lucia at a spot counts double. Track it at Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. Note: 100% completion only needs 15 spots, this trophy needs all 18.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand asks you to take down specific rare animals; study wildlife with your binoculars to find them. All 15 of Bret's Target Decks are also needed for 100% completion.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full Collectible Card sets. There are 18 sets in the world; 15 are needed for 100% completion. Cards hide in shops, houses and out in the world — check the Progress menu for which sets are close.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app at 100 locations. Scan vehicles and landmarks with the WAiNK app from the start of the game so the total builds naturally; it also feeds the 200-vehicle scan target for 100%.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. There are 80 challenges in total and 70 are needed for 100% completion, so push past 50 while you're at it.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star Wanted Level, then lose the cops and escape. Break line of sight, switch vehicles and lay low until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops back-to-back without losing your Wanted Level. Plan a route with three shops close together and move fast between them — if the wanted level clears, the chain resets.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive or scan new vehicles as you find them; the WAiNK app helps. 100% completion wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning past 100.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Group enemies first (a shootout with several close together works best), trigger Combat Focus and chain five kills before it ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a departing passenger aircraft from Vice City International Airport — get aboard as it taxis for an unscheduled departure. Expect a wanted level the moment you take it.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank and use it in combat. Rhino tanks appear at military sites; reported by KeenGamer, exact spawn details still being confirmed by other guides.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, avoid the cameras and guards, grab the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. The eight large bank vaults unlock with the Chapter 4 optional mission 'That's Where The Money Is…', so leave vaults until then.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Ambush a truck on the road, take the cash and break away before the police box you in.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida and uncover the complete map. Drive, sail and fly through every region until no fog is left on the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. Find each gang's operations around Leonida and hit at least one per gang.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guides — head to a bar overlooking Ocean Beach and order a cocktail. Marked unconfirmed until a second source pins it down.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The exact method is still unconfirmed by the guides — try driving out through the showroom glass. Marked unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: At the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, steal the three key valuables and escape. Get in, grab all three, and get out before security locks the place down.
trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Maximize the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train strength for each character (gym work, melee and heavy lifting all build it) until both bars are full.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions affecting your Criminal Profile. Crimes, robberies and other illicit acts all feed the profile — it builds naturally across a full playthrough. Warning from PowerPyx: avoid the 'Irredeemable' criminal profile, it is permanent and makes police more aggressive.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. The unlock method is still unconfirmed by every guide checked — don't trust a guess. Marked unconfirmed.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? The unlock method is still unconfirmed by every guide checked — likely a rare world event. Marked unconfirmed.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Perform a melee drive-by elimination (attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon); the precise method is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a cumulative $250,000 in Marked Bills through your contacts. Fence marked bills as you earn them; the 100% checklist also needs $250,000 fenced, so this overlaps fully.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Weapons, clothes, vehicles and property upgrades all count — it builds up naturally across the game.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all eight purchasable garage properties. Garages cost serious money, so save this for after the big heists when cash is plentiful.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app and register vehicles you own or find — any ten count.
trophies.name: On the Spot
